findings.current: Our party had swelled to well over a thousand, if you rounded up a bit, and we set off toward Gansu.
findings.defect: “Well over a thousand” makes the party substantially larger than the roughly thousand people reached by generous rounding.
findings.rationale: 반올림 좀 더해서 천여 명 qualifies the estimate; it does not say the party was well over a thousand.
findings.replacement: Our party had swelled to around a thousand, rounding up a bit, and we set off toward Gansu.
findings.source: 반올림 좀 더해서 천여 명으로 불어난 일행은 감숙성을 향해 이동을 시작했고

findings.current: At Jeok Cheongang’s muttered words, accompanied by a click of his tongue, I clicked mine too.
findings.defect: The draft gives Jeok Cheongang the narrator’s tongue-clicking action.
findings.rationale: Jeok smacks his lips; the narrator is the one who clicks his tongue.
findings.replacement: Jeok Cheongang smacked his lips as he muttered, and I clicked my tongue softly.
findings.source: 입맛을 다시며 중얼거리는 적천강의 모습에, 나는 작게 혀를 찼다.

findings.current: It wasn’t a shout, and there was no particular internal energy behind the low voice, though it came from a man speaking forcefully.
findings.defect: “Speaking forcefully” contradicts the description of a low voice without a forceful shout or internal energy behind it.
findings.rationale: The contrast is that the quiet, unamplified command stops the two Daoists.
findings.replacement: It was a low voice, neither shouted with force nor backed by any particular internal energy.
findings.source: 목에 힘을 주어 내지른 외침도, 별다른 공력도 실려 있지 않은 나직한 음성.

findings.current: The hooves of our grassland-bred horses thundered across the ground.
findings.defect: The draft changes the singular grassland horse into multiple horses.
findings.rationale: 초원마의 말발굽 describes the hooves of one horse as the narrator urges his mount forward.
findings.replacement: My grassland horse’s hooves thundered across the ground.

findings.defect: A deliberate correction from an initial form of address becomes a nervous stammer.
findings.rationale: 노, 아니 marks the narrator starting one address and correcting himself to 스승님.

findings.current: “From this moment until we reach Gansu, if any of you fall behind or try to slack off, this old man will personally give you a one-on-one lesson.”
findings.defect: “Lesson” turns Jeok’s euphemistic threat of a private meeting into an explicit training session.
findings.rationale: 개인 면담 is a private meeting or talk; the threat lies in who would conduct it.
findings.replacement: “From this moment until we reach Gansu, if any of you fall behind or try to slack off, this old man will personally have a private talk with you.”
findings.source: ‘지금 이 순간부터 감숙성에 도착하기 전까지, 조금이라도 뒤처지거나 뺀질대는 놈들은 노부가 친히 개인 면담을 해 주마.’

findings.current: “Senior Jeok, I was only trying to make sure…”
findings.defect: The draft changes the spoken address from 노 선배 to “Senior Jeok.”
findings.rationale: The speaker does not address him as 적 선배; “Senior” preserves the deference without substituting a different name.
findings.replacement: “Senior, I was only trying to make sure…”

findings.defect: The English loses the fact that the speaker identifies a bandit gang, rather than merely describing mounted bandits.
findings.rationale: 마적단 names a group or gang of mounted bandits.
findings.replacement: “Who else? That vicious gang of mounted bandits.”
findings.source: “누구긴 누굽니까요. 그 흉악하기 짝이 없는 마적단 놈들이지.”

summary: Several draft choices change the party’s size, physical actions, and the force of a spoken line. Two also lose a deliberate correction and the nature of Jeok Cheongang’s threat.
